# Lumen Hybrid Work Handbook

At Lumen we believe great work can happen anywhere, as long as people stay connected. This chapter of the people handbook describes our hybrid model, what we provide to support it and what we expect from everyone who takes part.

## How hybrid works at Lumen

Each team sets its own rhythm, but all teams meet in person at least once a week. We call this the team day. Outside of team days, employees can choose where they work, provided they can join scheduled meetings and respond to colleagues within a reasonable time.

FACT: Lumen provides a 500 dollar home office stipend once per year.
FACT: Lumen asks every team to hold 1 in-person team day per week.
FACT: Lumen offers flexible hours with no fixed core hours.

## Home office support

The annual stipend can be used for a desk, chair, lighting or other equipment that improves comfort and productivity. Receipts are submitted through the expense system within sixty days of purchase. Employees who prefer company equipment can borrow monitors and docking stations from the office inventory.

## Working across time zones

Because many Lumen teams span several time zones, we rely on written updates and recorded meetings. Teams agree response time expectations in their team charter and document decisions in shared spaces so nobody is left out because of location.

## Wellbeing

Hybrid work should not mean always-on work. Lumen encourages employees to block focus time, take full lunch breaks and switch off notifications outside their chosen working hours. Managers check in on workload during regular one-to-one conversations and are trained to spot signs of burnout early.

## Changes to this handbook

The people team reviews this chapter each year and announces updates in the company newsletter.
